newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro Petroleum ups 1997 capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro Petroleum ups 1997 capital budget.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp Tuesday said its 1997 capital budget is about $156 million, up more than 80 percent from the company's $85 million in capital spending during 1996.
The company said about 35 percent of its 1997 capital budget is allocated for acquisitions.
The company said about one-half of its total capital program will go toward diversifying its domestic and international oil and gas reserves.

During 1997, capital spending in the United States for oil and gas reserves has been set at $68 million, a 13 percent rise over 1996 spending. Of this amount,about $30 million is earmarked for new property acquisitions, the company said.
Outside the U.S., the company's 1997 oil and gas capital spending budget for Bolivia is estimated at $8 million where one well is scheduled to be drilled and seismic activity will continue.

Refining and marketing capital budget for 1997 is $50 million, including the $17 million refinery modification at the company's 72,000 barrel per day Kenai, Alaska refinery to increase jet fuel production.
Capital spending for 1997 for the company's Marine Services division is planned to be $29 million with about 85 percent earmarked for expansion of the company's Gulf of Mexico terminal operations.
